ideal: No thread needs an Allow card: the allow list and Auto mode cover its work. Any card is answered where asked, within minutes.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

quality: No two threads share a folder without a worktree.
speed: A card or prompt is answered where it was asked within 15 minutes.
